description: Verify that DUT-originated IPv4 UDP datagrams (within the local MTU) are unfragmented — MF=0 and Fragment Offset=0 in the IPv4 header (RFC 791 §3.2 p25 — DUT must not pre-fragment small datagrams)
approach:
[Objective]
Within the path MTU, datagrams should travel as a single fragment. DUT must emit MF=0 + offset=0 — pre-fragmenting would waste bytes and confuse middleboxes.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester → DUT: SOME/IP request that triggers DUT's UDP egress

2. Observation (3 s window):
   • DUT → Tester: IPv4 UDP datagram
      - MF flag           = 0   ← key check 1
      - Fragment Offset   = 0   ← key check 2

[Pass condition]
DUT's UDP datagram has MF=0 and offset=0.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_fragmented — DUT-originated UDP carried MF=1 or non-zero offset (DUT pre-fragmented)
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit UDP within the window

verdicts.Fail_fragmented: DUT-originated UDP carried fragment flags — pre-fragmenting under MTU
verdicts.Fail_timeout: DUT did not emit UDP within the window
